intro:
Kia talked about selling 20,000 Tasman utes in its first year – 15 months later it had sold 7,898. Here are the 10 biggest car disasters of 2026 in Australia, from bad to unbelievable: sales collapses, a cancelled Tesla, a stop-sale and recall, a brand dumped by its importer, and a Japanese giant whose own boss calls 2026 'the low point'.

All figures come from official VFACTS data and named reports (CarExpert, GoAuto, ACM and others). Low sales don't necessarily mean a car is bad – and if you own one of these, your warranty and consumer rights don't change.
